title: Decision Fatigue
hook: By 3pm, the big decision gets whatever's left of your brain.
explainer: Trivial choices burn the energy pricing and hiring need. Make them rules.
sop: Track every decision for one day.
Score Energy 1 to 10 and count Decisions.
equation_example: Energy 8 ÷ Decisions 40 = 0.2. Your tank is low and every call gets worse.
question: Name one daily decision you'll turn into a rule.
closing_statement: Save your brain for the big calls.
